chapters.label: Live: EURO 2012 quarter-final
chapters.text: Futsal Euro 2012. Spain, in white, against Romania. Kike back-heels to Alemao, a low ball across, Jordi Torras turns it in! One nil to Spain!

chapters.label: Replay: first to the ball
chapters.text: Watch again. Torras attacks the space and gets to the ball first. Later he curls in another, then rolls in a third. Three goals! Spain win eight three.

chapters.label: How he does it: the direct run
chapters.text: This is how he attacks from the wing. Run straight at the space in front of you. Beat your defender, then shoot early, before the block comes!
